audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradicted the prose sitting under them: Level 1 said Camille while whys[0] opens 'Even at level 1'; rows 4-5 and first item said Skill while whys[3] says 'She owns the lane-control window' and whys[5] says she out-trades your tank item; and 2+ items said Camille while whys[6] and spikes[3] both say the late game is 'genuinely yours'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Camille x5, K'Sante) matches the prose exactly on all four rows.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Skill / Camille / Camille / Camille / Camille / Camille / K'Sante in both layers, ratings adjusted, and phases[6].why rewritten to the tank-peel finish.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2-item spike was framed as a Camille window and gave no cooldown for her R.
audit.why: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140/115/90s — the longest cooldown in the lane. Surviving it once is a two-minute window early, and at two items you are the unkillable peel rather than the victim.
audit.corrected: 140s stated in whys[4], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns; phases[6].why now states what two items actually buys you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wrong ability name ('Hextech Ultimatum' — it is The Hextech Ultimatum), a Ntofo 'third-cast knock-up' that does not exist, Tactical Sweep called a true-damage cone, and Camille's percent-max-health SHIELD described as percent-health damage.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes shockwaves at TWO stacks and PULLS on a flat 3.5s. Tactical Sweep's outer half slows and heals her — the true damage in the lane is on Precision Protocol. Adaptive Defenses grants a shield equal to a percentage of CAMILLE's max health against the damage type that hit her, so 'her percent-HP shreds you' inverts the mechanic and tells you to build the wrong thing.
audit.corrected: Full name used, two-stack pull written into spikes[0] and wants.you[1], Tactical Sweep's heal stated in spikes[2], the shield stated in dontsFull[0].d, and the shred re-attributed to her true damage in whys[6] and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that her R can carry her through your commit, and nothing said Hookshot needs terrain.
audit.why: The _missing file lists untargetable-dodges-burst for The Hextech Ultimatum, and Riot's text for Hookshot is 'pulls herself to a wall' — in open lane she has no engage at all.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: That is Camille's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

notes: The percent-health misread was the dangerous one: Adaptive Defenses is a shield sized off CAMILLE's max health, not percent-health damage against yours, and two places told the reader her damage scales with his HP stacking. That argues for the wrong build. The chart also disagreed with its own prose on four of seven rows and is now aligned to the packet. 'W-charge unstoppable' survives in content.early — Riot's text gives K'Sante's W charge-up damage reduction only, so unstoppable stays UNVERIFIED and untouched.
